summary: Settings for the Next.js build tool, turning off image optimisation and loading two PDF packages as plain Node code.
purpose: Makes the build work with PDF reading and with the image setup the app uses.
why: Likely reason: the comment says the PDF packages use workers and canvas that the bundler cannot package. Reason for the image setting not stated in the code.
how: 1. Turns off automatic image resizing. 2. Lists two PDF packages to be loaded at runtime instead of being bundled.
inputs: Nothing at runtime. Read during the build.
risks: Removing the PDF entry can break PDF reading. With image optimisation off, pictures are served at their original size, which can slow pages.
debug: If PDF parsing fails in production, check this list and the package versions in package.json.
